case_name: V4 item V03 on the MCP: Three-clip zoo ad with a voice-over and a logo end card
title: Three-clip zoo ad with a voice-over and a logo end card

turns.text: A 45-second widescreen (16:9) YouTube ad for Ridgeview Zoo in three clips with a warm, friendly voice-over: lions at dawn, then penguins being fed, then giraffes at the treetops; end on a clean logo card that reads exactly 'Ridgeview Zoo' in green and gold with a simple antelope mark and the line 'Open daily 9–5 · Kids under 5 free'. The voice-over invites families to visit this weekend.

answer_sheet.Budget: go ahead, make all of it

must_haves: Three clips or one film with lions, penguins, giraffes in order.
A warm friendly voice-over inviting families.
An end card reading exactly 'Ridgeview Zoo' in green and gold with 'Open daily 9–5 · Kids under 5 free'.
